name: How long does it take to complete a custom molding project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a custom molding project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom molding project varies significantly based on its complexity, the volume of molding required, and the chosen materials. Design and fabrication can take several weeks, especially for intricate profiles or rare wood species. Installation time depends on the project's scope, including surface preparation, cutting, fitting, and finishing. A small room with custom baseboards might take a few days, while an entire home with complex crown molding could extend to several weeks. Your contractor will provide a detailed schedule after assessing the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom molding project timelines vary based on complexity, volume, and materials; design/fabrication can take weeks, and installation varies from days for small projects to weeks for large ones.
